question: Which among the following instruments is used for measuring the humidity of the air or a gas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hygrometer**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hygrometer:

 
 
• This is a device used to measure the amount of humidity and water vapor in the atmosphere, in soil, or in confined spaces.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bolometer: **

 
 
• This is an instrument used to **measure the power of incident electromagnetic radiation.**
 
• It is typically used in** infrared astronomy.**
 
 
 
• Hydrometer:
 
 
• This is an instrument used to measure the specific gravity (or relative density) of liquids
 
• That is the ratio of the density of the liquid to the density of water.
 
 
 
• **Altimeter:**
 
 
• This is an instrument used to **measure the altitude of an object above a fixed level.**
 
• The true altitude is the elevation above mean sea level.
 
• Altimeters are commonly used in **aircraft, hiking, and mountain climbing.**
